demos.name: Customer Agent LAB
demos.description: The customer-facing AI agent of the AI-DEMO2 demo with all 87 of its use cases in eight tracks: delegation with an act claim, authorize decisions, step-up and human approval, gateway attacks and refusals. A simulation: a mock engine produces every token and hop offline.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5600). Docker: HOST_PORT=5601 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Open the page at the url (npm run build first for the host-run form; the Docker image builds it). Mock by default. Live (host-run only, owner opt-in: CAL_ALLOW_LIVE=1, IDP=pingone, PingOne settings in the shared file) makes two real calls to one PingOne environment and is UNVERIFIED on a real tenant.
